explanations.6: The ${2:-.} syntax means: use the second argument if provided, otherwise default to a dot (current directory).
explanations.19: The date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S command creates a timestamp like '20240115-143022' to make each backup file unique.
explanations.25: The -C flag tells tar to change into the source's parent directory first, so the archive contains just the folder name instead of the full path.
